Name: Resheph
Summary: Son of Rephah and father of Telah in Ephraim's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:25: Son of Rephah and father of Telah in Ephraim's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Resheph stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
